decision.rationale: TXN-008136 is a 32.31 EUR purchase at Willowmere Apparel (MER-000069) on card CRD-000125. It posted on 2026-08-28. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-29, 62 days later, which is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The merchant's order confirmation (DOC-000073) gives an expected delivery date of 2026-09-05. The dispute was opened 54 days after that date, so the 15-day waiting period in goods-not-received-wait has passed. The case contains no carrier delivery confirmation, so nothing shows the order was delivered. The card has no refund from the merchant. The cardholder's email of 2026-09-13 (DOC-000074) shows they asked the merchant about the order and received no reply. The wait has passed, nothing shows delivery and the merchant has not resolved the matter, so goods-not-received-merchant-evidence requires asking the merchant for proof of delivery. This category does not allow a credit at this stage.

proposed_actions.note: Please send proof of delivery for the order placed on 2026-08-27 for 32.31 EUR. It should be the carrier's delivery record showing delivery to the cardholder's address, signed for by the cardholder.
